main_body: Round tree canopy of overlapping leaf clumps on a thin brown trunk, with a flat ground-shadow ellipse at the base
top_band: At x=12, rows 1-2 are a dark green outline, rows 3-4 mid-dark green (#254a32), and rows 5-7 mid green (#34633c). The canopy top is rounded and lit, with lighter clump highlights (#689e63) lower down at rows 16-18.
evidence: This is an organic rounded canopy, not a flat elevation. The clumps show lit upper-left highlights and dark undersides, and the trunk and ground-shadow ellipse sit below. The canopy bottom (rows 20-28) is shaded darker, and the trunk (rows 30-43) is a vertical support. No receding side face is drawn. For an organic tree this reads as an acceptable 3/4 form.

style.evidence: The candidate uses only 11 distinct colours and a median of 9 per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. The references have many leaf clumps in several greens, branches visible inside the crown and root detail. The candidate has a smooth blob canopy with a few large same-tone patches, a plain 2-3px trunk and a flat ground ellipse. The outline is a dark green tint (0% neutral), which is good, and there are no 5x5 flat fills. The shading ramp is about 5 greens, but it is applied coarsely. Next to the references it looks far thinner and simpler.
